packet.title: Evaluator performance, second round (implementation)
packet.summary: A second round of general evaluator speed-ups from profiling: a fast path for number conversion, inline item lists and matcher frames, single-node atomization, numeric index keys and quantified hoisting.

body.p: After (perf-1: its benchmarks, and what it left: describe_node 15 % and the machine loop 12 % of XMark-All, atomization, reference counts and small sequences, numeric index keys, hoisting of path MAPs, quantified expressions and sorts, the $V[. instance of gnode()] check per match="$var" test).

item.p: Mechanism: profile first (callgrind), then general mechanisms of the one IR and evaluator for the hot spots; 's rule (no IR pass moves STREAM bindings), and honest step counts kept.

Owns: src/evaluator.c, src/evaluator_function.c, src/evaluator_path.c, src/evaluator_index.c, src/ir_loop_passes.c, src/tree_axis.c, src/arena_tree.c, src/tree.c, src/cast*.c, src/decimal.c, src/xdm*.c, tests/bench/.

Done when: each change measured before and after, the numbers in its commit and in a D-record; no QT4 XQ40 or XT40 outcome changes. Done 2026-10-19 (): Clinger's fast path for numbers to doubles; leaves in place; inline item lists and matcher frames; single-node atomization; the memoized match="$var" type check; numeric index keys; quantified hoisting. xmark-all 12.29 to 9.84 x 10^9 instructions (1.55 to 1.20 s), match="$var" 9.30 to 3.91; QT4 XQ40 and XT40 unchanged case by case.
